title: IiWRKY34 Regulates Plant Root Growth Through a Direct Interaction With NAC1 and Its Interactor NAC18 in Isatis indigotica.
authors: Feng, Jingxian; Yao, Yuan; Ma, Xueqi; Chen, Wansheng; Xiao, Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物转录因子IiWRKY34通过直接结合DNA启动子调控根生长，并含分子对接模拟TF-DNA复合物，但核心是植物发育调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上仅简单对接，深度有限。
abstract: WRKY34 transcription factor has a substantial role in inducing the accumulation of bioactive lignan compounds, improving the biomass of hairy roots, and increasing stress tolerance in Isatis indigotica. However, the precise role of the IiWRKY34 transcriptional network in modulating root growth remains to be elucidated. Here, we observed that heterogeneous expression of IiWRKY34 increased the primary root length in Arabidopsis thaliana. IiWRKY34 bound directly to the promoter of IiNAC1, which itself bound to the promoter of an auxin biosynthesis gene, IiYUCCA6. Molecular docking displayed the complex of IiWRKY34-DBD and the DNA duplex of W-box on the promoter. Additionally, an interaction occurred between IiNAC1 and IiNAC18, and heterogeneous expression of either transcription factor resulted in the same phenotype as IiWRKY34-expressing lines of A. thaliana. Thus, we believe that IiWRKY34 functions as an upstream trigger of auxin signaling during root growth. The resulting model clarifies the molecular mechanism of IiWRKY34-regulated root growth, which may have applications in enhancing agricultural yields of I. indigotica and possibly other plants in the family Brassicaceae.
abstract_zh: WRKY34转录因子在诱导菘蓝中生物活性木脂素类化合物积累、提高毛状根生物量以及增强胁迫耐受性方面具有重要作用。然而，IiWRKY34转录网络在调节根生长中的精确作用仍有待阐明。在本研究中，我们观察到IiWRKY34的异源表达增加了拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）的主根长度。IiWRKY34直接结合IiNAC1的启动子，而IiNAC1本身又结合生长素生物合成基因IiYUCCA6的启动子。分子对接显示了IiWRKY34-DBD与启动子上W-box DNA双链体的复合物结构。此外，IiNAC1与IiNAC18之间存在相互作用，且任一转录因子的异源表达在拟南芥中均产生与IiWRKY34表达株系相同的表型。因此，我们认为IiWRKY34在根生长过程中作为生长素信号的上游触发因子发挥作用。所得模型阐明了IiWRKY34调控根生长的分子机制，这可能对提高菘蓝及十字花科（Brassicaceae）其他植物的农业产量具有应用价值。
